entities.name: Ponç Hug IV, Count of Empúries
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ponç V or Ponç Hug IV was the Count of Empúries from 1277 until his death and viscount of Bas from 1285 to 1291. He was the son and successor of Hug V and Sibila de Palau.
